title: Recap: probability adverbs, and why probability is not duty

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know the probability adverbs *feltehetőleg* and *minden bizonnyal* from C1 Unit 3. In medical ethics they must not be confused with duty: they say what is likely, while *elvárható* and *kötelesség* say what has to be done.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Even if an operation will almost certainly succeed (*minden bizonnyal sikeres lesz*), it cannot be done without the patient's informed consent: probability does not replace duty.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Az orvostól elvárható gondosság etikai és jogi kötelesség.
Due care expected of a physician is an ethical and legal duty.
A beavatkozás minden bizonnyal meghosszabbítja az életet, de kockázatos.
The intervention in all certainty prolongs life, but is risky.
A terápia folytatása szigorú orvosetikai mérlegelés tárgyát képezi.
Continuation of therapy forms the subject of strict medical-ethical deliberation.
